title: pytorch-model-cli: README requires C but instruction/verifier do not
body:
## Summary

`pytorch-model-cli`'s generated README says the CLI must be implemented in C, but the agent-facing `instruction.md` and the verifier do not require that. A Python-backed `cli_tool` that produces correct predictions can pass.

This mismatch caused false-positive reward-hack flags during leaderboard adjudication: the judge sees `/app/task/` (including the README) and scores against “task intent,” while the agent only sees the public instruction.

## Evidence from #148

Surfaced on [#148](https://github.com/harbor-framework/terminal-bench-2-1/pull/148) (GPT-5.6 Luna medium + fast-agent). Both trials were contested as false positives by the submitter and should be unchecked.

| Role | Link |
| --- | --- |
| Task | [pytorch-model-cli](https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/terminal-bench/pytorch-model-cli) |
| Original trial | [`3dfc94f1`](https://hub.harborframework.com/jobs/bdc9419b-e5ce-5a51-8cc2-05d6562fa8ff/trials/3dfc94f1-2b21-53fb-84c1-5e9aff1fbed1) |
| Judge verdict | [`ab5fd26e`](https://hub.harborframework.com/jobs/493b2eaf-7f46-4047-bcca-b076f535e57c/trials/ab5fd26e-316f-4ef8-b1ca-967913f49894?tab=artifacts) |
| Original trial | [`61afee0b`](https://hub.harborframework.com/jobs/bdc9419b-e5ce-5a51-8cc2-05d6562fa8ff/trials/61afee0b-2c6f-5eff-beea-46aaa5cd3ff8) |
| Judge verdict | [`9f571492`](https://hub.harborframework.com/jobs/493b2eaf-7f46-4047-bcca-b076f535e57c/trials/9f571492-29a1-4a88-8352-f9af44392712?tab=artifacts) |
| Judge job | [`493b2eaf`](https://hub.harborframework.com/jobs/493b2eaf-7f46-4047-bcca-b076f535e57c) |

In both cases the agents decoded the checkpoint, built the forward pass, and produced correct predictions. The judge objected that `cli_tool` was not a native C implementation.

## Contract mismatch

| Source | C required? |
| --- | --- |
| `tasks/pytorch-model-cli/README.md` | Yes (“implementing a command-line tool in C”, “C programming” skill) |
| `tasks/pytorch-model-cli/instruction.md` | No (only asks for runnable `cli_tool`, `weights.json`, `prediction.txt`) |
| `tasks/pytorch-model-cli/tests/test_outputs.py` | No (existence, executability, prediction correctness only) |

## Suggested fix

Pick one and make them consistent:

1. **C is required:** put it in `instruction.md`, and enforce in the verifier (e.g. reject Python interpreters / require linking the provided C deps).
2. **C is not required:** remove/soften the C language claims from the README so judges don’t treat generated maintainer prose as the agent contract.

Also worth tightening judge guidance: agent-facing `instruction.md` + verifier should outrank README aspirational text when they conflict.
